orbit.quote: The operational orbit chosen for TESS is a highly eccentric, 2:1 lunar resonance orbit of 108,400 by 376,300 kilometers at an inclination of 37 degrees

sector.quote: TESS observes the sky in sectors measuring 24° x 96°. Each sector is observed for two orbits of the satellite around the Earth, or about 27 days on average.

source.name: MIT TESS Science Office: TESS Observations

cameras.quote: then (RA, dec, roll) in degrees (J2000) of the spacecraft and four camera boresights

source.name: MIT TESS Science Office: TESS Observations

pole.quote: a 24° diameter region centered on the ecliptic pole can be observed for nearly a full year

source.name: MIT TESS Science Office: TESS Observations
